decision.decision: Keep the retained scalar GDN runtime. The bounded state and bounded state/output variants pass the native numerical boundaries but take longer in the complete captured component with production U=V ownership. This implementation is not selected for a real-model trial or package. Admission percentages alone do not establish speed; these measurements do not isolate the hardware cost of individual added operations.

timing_scope: One warmup and three rotated completed-host samples per variant and ownership mode cover paired scores, W/U, recurrent state and output in1024-token segments. Certificates, original fallback queues, barriers and arithmetic are included. Allocation, uploads, reference comparison, normalization, gate scans, KKT and inversion are outside the interval. Original q7169 includes all captured checkpoints and final state. The q8192 extension repeats1024 captured rows after7168 original rows. This is not a new8192-token prompt or real-model performance result.
